title: Mean of the minority indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$. The uniform mean of its nearly constant minority indicator is $\bigl(1-|\mathbb E f|\bigr)/2$, where $\mathbb E f$ is the uniform mean of $f$ viewed as real-valued.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the sign cube
